description: Checks a social landlord's Awaab's Law timescales in England (section 10A of the Landlord and Tenant Act 1985 and the Hazards in Social Housing (Prescribed Requirements) (England) Regulations 2025, S.I. 2025/1042, in force from 27 October 2025 for damp and mould and for emergency hazards): the investigation, the written summary, the safety work, alternative accommodation and supplementary preventative work, each with its deadline and whether it was met, counting working days or 24-hour periods. It does not decide whether a hazard is significant or an emergency: that is a question of fact. Give the hazard, the timescale (track) and the date the landlord became aware; add later dates to check each step.

adviceGiven.description: The date a safety advice document was given (optional) (YYYY-MM-DD).

alt.description: Alternative accommodation: "none" recorded (default), "provided", or "refused" (the tenant refused an offer).

altDate.description: Where provided: the date alternative accommodation was provided from (YYYY-MM-DD).

altTime.description: Where provided: the time (24-hour HH:MM). Leave out if not known.

asAt.description: Check as at this date (defaults to today) (YYYY-MM-DD).

askedInspection.description: The tenant asked for a physical inspection.

aware.description: The date the landlord became aware of the issue (a report, complaint, inspection or letter of claim) (YYYY-MM-DD).

awareTime.description: Emergency: the time the landlord became aware (24-hour HH:MM). Leave out if not known.

fireLocation.description: For a fire hazard: "inside" (inside a flat, or anywhere in a house) or "block" (a building with two or more homes: its structure, external walls, common parts or a flat's front door).

firstOutcome.description: Where there was a renewed investigation: what the first one found, "none" or "significant".

firstWasPhysical.description: Whether the first investigation included a physical inspection: "yes", "no" or "" if not known.

further.description: The date the further investigation was completed (YYYY-MM-DD).

furtherHazard.description: Where outcome is "further": the hazard found.

furtherTime.description: The time the further investigation was completed (24-hour HH:MM). Leave out if not known.

groundsDate.description: Where groundsLater: when the grounds arose (YYYY-MM-DD).

groundsLater.description: Emergency: reasonable grounds to believe there was an emergency arose later than awareness.

groundsTime.description: Where groundsLater: the time the grounds arose (24-hour HH:MM). Leave out if not known.

hazard.description: The hazard: "damp" (Damp, mould or fungal growth), "excess-cold" (Excess cold), "excess-heat" (Excess heat), "hygiene" (Domestic hygiene, including food, pests, waste and sanitation), "falls-level" (Falls on the level, including baths and showers), "falls-stairs" (Falls on stairs, steps or ramps), "falls-between" (Falls between levels), "electrical" (Electrical hazards), "fire" (Fire and smoke), "explosion" (Explosions), "collapse" (Structural collapse or falling elements), "other" (Another housing hazard (e.g. water supply, carbon monoxide or gas, intruders)), "crowding" (Crowding and space).

inspectionRequested.description: Where askedInspection: the date of the request (YYYY-MM-DD).

investigated.description: The date the investigation (or emergency investigation) was completed (YYYY-MM-DD).

investigatedTime.description: Emergency: the time the investigation was completed (24-hour HH:MM). Leave out if not known.

knewBefore.description: The landlord knew of the problem before the regulations applied to it (reg 21).

landlord.description: "social" for a council or housing association (default), "private" or "other". Awaab's Law covers social housing.

outcome.description: What the latest investigation found: "none" (no significant or emergency hazard), "significant", "emergency", or "further" (a hazard, but a further investigation was needed).

prevBy.description: Which investigation identified the preventative work: "first" (and it could begin at once), "first-wait" (it needed the further investigation first) or "further".

preventative.description: Whether supplementary preventative work was identified (reg 13): "yes", "no" or "" if not known.

renewed.description: A renewed investigation (reg 7): the date it was completed (YYYY-MM-DD).

renewedTime.description: The time the renewed investigation was completed (24-hour HH:MM). Leave out if not known.

safetyBy.description: Where outcome is "further": which investigation identified the safety work.

safetyDone.description: The date the safety work was completed (YYYY-MM-DD).

safetyDoneTime.description: Emergency: the time the safety work was completed (24-hour HH:MM). Leave out if not known.

stepsTaken.description: The date steps were taken to arrange the preventative work (e.g. a contractor booked) (YYYY-MM-DD).

summary1.description: The date the written summary was given after the first investigation (handed over, posted or emailed) (YYYY-MM-DD).

summary2.description: The date the written summary was given after the renewed investigation (YYYY-MM-DD).

summary3.description: The date the written summary was given after the further investigation (YYYY-MM-DD).

workBegan.description: The date the preventative work began (YYYY-MM-DD).

workCompleted.description: The date the preventative work was completed (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: check_awaabs_law_timescales
title: Awaab's Law timescales checker (S.I. 2025/1042)
